ARTICLE_1.TITLE: 1. My story
ARTICLE_1.SUBTITLE: Merging worlds.
ARTICLE_1.CONTENT:
My journey began in the world of volume and light. As a 3D artist, I learned to sculpt the digital, to understand the physics of materials and the importance of visual detail. 
 Today, I transpose this aesthetic rigor into web development. Code has become my new brush, allowing me to build not only objects and characters, but interactive and living universes.
ARTICLE_1.IMAGE_ALT: image from the short film D.S. Al Coda, released in 2024

ARTICLE_2.TITLE: 2. Projects
ARTICLE_2.SUBTITLE: Recent works
ARTICLE_2.CONTENT: A variety of projects, whether it's two films made during my 5 years of master's degree or this site, my first portfolio, mixing various web development skills.

ARTICLE_IA.CONTENT_1: This site was developed as part of a learning process. In order to make real progress, I chose to limit the use of artificial intelligence to the bare minimum. All the code was written by hand, and AI was only used to check certain syntax, correct code that had already been written, or for other small tasks related in particular to CSS.
ARTICLE_IA.CONTENT_2: AI-assisted autocomplete was only introduced at the very end of the project, mainly for translation. My primary aim was to understand every line of code written and to gain a practical mastery of the technologies used.
